motion.name: scan
motion.purpose: Rotates the active scan indicator; removed when reduced motion is requested.

motion.name: target-emphasis
motion.purpose: Briefly emphasizes a selected live-page target; removed when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Starts or retries the explicit local scan.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent, #5b35d5); color: #fff; font: 700 13px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #4524b4); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #006dcc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Runs a quiet secondary action such as rescan.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d5d5d0); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #17171b); font: 700 12px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-raised, #f0f0ed); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #006dcc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Select
components.description: Narrows the finding ledger by one explicit dimension.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: var(--muted, #5d5d67); font: 700 10px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .03em; } .ds-filter select { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 28px 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d5d5d0); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #17171b); font: 12px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-filter select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #006dcc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Overlay Toggle
components.description: Shows the pressed state for the page-overlay control.
components.css: .ds-overlay-toggle { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #5b35d5); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent-soft, #ece7ff); color: var(--accent-hover, #4524b4); font: 700 12px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-overlay-toggle:hover { background: var(--surface-raised, #f0f0ed); } .ds-overlay-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #006dcc); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-finding { padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #5b35d5); border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #17171b); box-shadow: inset 4px 0 var(--accent, #5b35d5); font: 12px/1.45 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-finding strong { display: block; font: 700 13px/1.3 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-finding span { display: block; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--accent, #5b35d5); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-finding p { margin: 7px 0 9px; } .ds-finding code { display: block; overflow: hidden; padding: 7px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-raised, #f0f0ed); color: #303038; font: 11px/1.4 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Review Notice
components.description: Presents a coverage limit or item requiring human review.

components.name: Live Target Overlay
components.description: Connects a selected finding to its exact live-page element.
components.css: .ds-target { position: relative; width: 220px; height: 110px; border: 5px solid #7c3aed; background: rgb(124 58 237 / 14%); outline: 2px solid #fff; } .ds-target span { position: absolute; top: -24px; left: -5px; max-width: 240px; overflow: hidden; padding: 3px 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #111827; color: #fff; font: 600 12px/18px ui-monospace, monospace; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-target:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #006dcc); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a restrained developer instrument: page identity, scan state, filters, findings, and live-target feedback read as one continuous inspection record. Neutral ink and paper-like surfaces carry most of the interface; violet is reserved for actions and selection, while amber identifies review work.

Information density is intentional. Square finding rows, hairline rules, compact labels, and monospace evidence make repeated scanning fast without turning the side panel into a generic dashboard. The voice stays direct, local, and factual.
keyCharacteristics: Flat neutral surfaces separated by 1px rules.
One violet action and selection accent, with amber reserved for review cues.
Dense ledger rows instead of detached cards or metric tiles.
System UI for explanation; monospace for rule IDs, evidence, tags, and overlay labels.
Visible focus and textual status labels; meaning never relies on color alone.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep violet rare and operational. Do not distribute additional decorative accent colors through the side panel.

rules.name: The Evidence Channel Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only when the text names or quotes technical evidence; explanatory prose remains sans-serif.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce card shadows or floating dashboard layers; use rules, surface tone, and inset selection instead.

dos: Do preserve the sequence page identity → explicit scan → filters → selected finding → live target.
Do use 1px rules and shared edges to keep dense results legible.
Do retain visible text for violation, needs-review, impact, error, and coverage states.
Do keep focus visible with the established 3px blue outline and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do adapt long page metadata and filters at the established 320px narrow-panel breakpoint.
donts: Don't turn counts or findings into detached dashboard tiles.
Don't use monospace for general product copy or explanation.
Don't add shadows, gradients, decorative color, or rounded containers to create hierarchy.
Don't communicate severity, review status, or selection by color alone.
Don't imply that a clean automated scan proves accessibility compliance.
